title: The Buttons Spilled on the Step
youtube_title: The Buttons Spilled on the Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a jar of buttons spilled down the step is awkward for one person. Idris notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
